description:
Found by the fz-kdt.185 full-corpus warning census at `40563eeb756636153df0aac67d01940864fe2556`.

## Status

LIVE, nonblocking follow-on at the fz-tfn epic tail. After fz-kdt.185 gives exact domains to membership and with-index helpers, `enum_map_family` still reports 13 controlled `warning[type/no-matching-clause]` diagnostics from the same runtime-library contract-evidence class.

## Goal

Give every remaining private Enum list walker the exact producer-owned domain it consumes, so empty/cons coverage is total by construction. Do not suppress diagnostics, add wildcard clauses for impossible values, or infer helper authority from whichever activations one program happened to create.

## Live population

The remaining warnings name:

- `map_list`
- `filter_list`
- `flat_map_list`
- `concat_list`
- `map_reduce_list`
- `scan_first`
- `scan_list`
- `intersperse_list` and `intersperse_tail`
- `map_join_list` and `map_join_tail`
- `map_intersperse_list` and `map_intersperse_tail`

The current durable reproducer is `fixtures2/behavior/enum_map_family.fz`; its diagnostics sidecar contains the exact lines.

## Strategy

Use the semantic Output Contract Loop. Pin the 13-warning RED at the production diagnostic boundary; trace each callers actual list/callback/accumulator/result relation; declare the smallest shared type schemes at the runtime source authority; then delete the superseded warning golden rows. Fold concordant helper families and avoid thirteen one-off fixes.

## Acceptance

- `enum_map_family` retains exact Elixir-owned stdout on run, interp, and build while all 13 named warnings disappear.
- Exact contracts preserve element, callback, accumulator, and result correlations; valid public Enum inputs are not narrowed.
- Genuine user partial functions still warn.
- Full-corpus diagnostic movers are only proved removals from this named population; stdout and exit status do not move.
- Canonical artifact and causal-work movers are classified deterministically.
- Obsolete warning sidecars/rows and stale documentation are deleted after cutover.
- Focused RED/GREEN tests, formatting, strict clippy, doctests, library tests, and the serial fixture matrix pass.
